title: Armor of Agathys
contents: text | ComponentsV, S, M (a cup of water)
text | A magical frost covers you, gaining 5 temporary hit points.
text | While these remain, any creature that hits you with a melee attack takes 5 cold damage.
text | At Higher Levels. Temp HP and cold damage increase by 5 for each slot level above 1st.

title: Arms of Hadar
contents: text | Tendrils of dark energy erupt around you.
text | Each creature in the area must make a Strength saving throw. On a fail, it takes 2d6 necrotic damage and can't take reactions until its next turn.
text | On a success, it takes half damage and no other effect.
text | At Higher Levels. Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 1st.

title: Bane
contents: text | ComponentsV, S, M (a drop of blood)
text | Up to 3 creatures must make a Charisma saving throw. On a fail, they subtract 1d4 from attack rolls and saving throws for the duration.
text | At Higher Levels. Target one additional creature per slot level above 1st.

title: Charm Person
contents: text | You attempt to charm a humanoid you can see within range.
text | It must make a Wisdom saving throw, with advantage if you or your companions are fighting it.
text | On a failed save, the creature is charmed by you until the spell ends or until you or your allies do anything harmful to it.
text | The charmed creature regards you as a friendly acquaintance.

text | At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can target one additional humanoid for each slot level above 1st. The humanoids must be within 30 feet of each other.

title: Comprehend Languages
contents: text | ComponentsV, S, M (a pinch of soot and salt)
text | For the duration, you understand the literal meaning of any spoken language you hear.
text | You also understand written languages, but must be touching the surface the words are on.
text | It takes 1 minute to read one page of text.

title: Detect Magic
contents: text | For the duration, you sense the presence of magic within 30 feet of you.
text | If you sense magic, you can use your action to see a faint aura around any visible creature or object that bears magic, and you learn its school, if any.
text | The spell can penetrate most barriers, but is blocked by 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of metal, or 3 feet of wood or dirt.

title: Expeditious Retreat
contents: text | This spell allows you to move at an incredible pace.
text | When you cast this spell, and then as a bonus action on each of your turns, you can take the Dash action.

title: Hellish Rebuke
contents: text | Casting Time1 reaction (when you take damage)
text | You point your finger, and the creature that damaged you is momentarily surrounded by hellish flames.
text | The creature must make a Dexterity saving throw.
text | It takes 2d10 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success.
text | At Higher Levels. Damage increases by 1d10 per slot level above 1st.

title: Hex
contents: text | ComponentsV, S, M (petrified eye of a newt)
text | You place a curse on a creature you can see.
text | Until the spell ends, it takes 1d6 necrotic damage whenever you hit it with an attack.
text | Also, choose one ability—target has disadvantage on ability checks made with the chosen ability.
text | At Higher Levels. Duration increases with slot level: 8 hours (3rd+), 24 hours (5th), 1 week (7th+).

title: Illusory Script
contents: text | You write on a surface, making the text appear normal, written in your hand, and conveying whatever meaning you intend to the intended viewer.
text | To others, it appears as unintelligible or as another message entirely.
text | A creature with truesight can see the true script. Detect Magic reveals illusion.

title: Protection from Evil and Good
contents: section | Protection from Evil and Good
text | ComponentsV, S, M (holy water or silver and iron)
text | One willing creature you touch is protected from aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, and undead.
text | These creatures have disadvantage on attack rolls against the target, and the target can't be charmed, frightened, or possessed by them.
text | If the target is already charmed, frightened, or possessed, it has advantage on new saving throws against the effect.

title: Speak with Animals
contents: text | For the duration, you gain the ability to comprehend and verbally communicate with beasts.
text | The knowledge and awareness of many beasts is limited by their intelligence, but they can give you information about nearby locations, monsters, or recent events.

title: Tasha's Hideous Laughter
contents: text | ComponentsV, S, M (tiny tart and feather)
text | A creature of your choice perceives everything as hilariously funny and falls into fits of laughter if it fails a Wisdom saving throw.
text | It falls prone and becomes incapacitated. At the end of each of its turns and each time it takes damage, it can make another save.

title: Unseen Servant
contents: text | ComponentsV, S, M (piece of string and bit of wood)
text | This spell creates an invisible, mindless, shapeless force that performs simple tasks at your command.
text | It can fetch, clean, mend, hold, or open things. It has AC 10, 1 HP, STR 2, and can't attack.

title: Witch Bolt
contents: text | ComponentsV, S, M (twig from a tree struck by lightning)
text | A beam of crackling blue energy lances out toward a creature.
text | Make a ranged spell attack; on hit, it takes 1d12 lightning damage, and on subsequent turns you can use your action to deal another 1d12 automatically.
text | The spell ends if the target moves out of range or has total cover.
